payload.title: [Fig. 2] Naïve sampling
payload.description: This workflow involves analyzing climate data using naïve sampling techniques. It calculates the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between a target series and ensemble trajectories, performs spectral analysis, and visualizes the results.

steps.description: Load necessary libraries and climate model data. Set up the plotting style and load the ensemble time series data from a NetCDF file.
steps.title: Data Loading and Initial Setup

steps.description: Create a new pandas DataFrame to store processed data, remove unnecessary columns, calculate ensemble means, and display the processed data.
steps.title: Data Processing

steps.description: Compute the Mean Squared Error between the target series and all possible trajectories within the ensemble.
steps.title: Mean Squared Error Calculation

steps.description: Perform spectral analysis on the original and resampled data using the multitaper method. Generate and anti-alias the power spectral density (PSD) objects.
steps.title: Spectral Analysis

steps.description: Create visualizations of the analysis results, including the closest match and naïve resampling plots.
steps.title: Visualization
